summary: A streamlined, faster reboot of the classic Caylus, where players place workers to gather resources and construct buildings along the castle's road for points and bonuses. It keeps the worker-placement bones of the original but trims playtime and adds variable setup and character powers for more replayability.
praised: Faithful modernization that keeps Caylus's strategic depth
Shorter playtime than the original Caylus
criticised: Some feel it loses a bit of the original's grandeur
Still fairly dry/economic for players wanting theme
Comparisons to the original divide opinion on which is better

interaction.kind: worker placement with shared building slots and take-that elements
interaction.detail: Players place workers on shared action spots that others can also use (with the provost/turn-order mechanic affecting who benefits), and buildings placed by one player can be used by others for a fee. Most resource management happens on a shared board rather than isolated player boards.

scoring.why: Points come from buildings constructed, prestige tiles, favor track progress, and end-game bonuses, several of which are hidden until scoring.
scoring.how_you_win: Players place workers on action spaces to gather resources and erect buildings around the growing castle; the player with the most victory points, tallied from multiple independent tracks and bonuses at the end, wins.
